Author: Macki
Name: Glance
Description: Public beta. Meet your character's gaze during idle close-ups. Choose Wink, Playful, Friendly, Dramatic, Expressive, Custom, or gaze-only mode in /glance. Expressive adds Joy/Pose body motions. Camera tracking and expression timing are experimental. Icon created with AI assistance.
Punchline: A little eye contact. A little personality.
Changelog: Optional Extended close-up: scroll closer than the normal minimum with a 0.10–1.50 yalm distance slider. Keeps your own character visible during third-person close-ups. Disabled by default; restores camera limits on disable, unload and activity pauses. Experimental; requires in-game testing.
